dct_description_sm: To obtain atmospheric composition data for furthering understanding of atmospheric processes, particularly with reference to surface ozone and mercury depletion. This study was part of OASIS-Canada program and the CFL (Circumpolar Flaw Lead) campaign. Complementary data are available in the Polar Data Catalogue, CCIN Reference Number 1843.
dct_title_s: OASIS-CANADA CFL: Atmospheric composition and structure during the CFL campaign from the Amundsen icebreaker in the Amundsen Gulf
